objective.jobToBeDone: Create new projects and manage their full lifecycle — from registration through activation, hold, closure, or cancellation — from a single workspace.
objective.primaryDecision: Which lifecycle action to take on a project right now: create a new one, edit its details, or transition its status.
objective.usageFrequency: Occasional / back-office — used by project managers when onboarding new projects or responding to lifecycle events (activation, hold, closure).

criticalActions.presentation: primary-button on a dedicated creation form panel
inline-row-command / edit panel pre-populated from selected project
contextual-transition-actions — one button per valid next status on the selected project, never a free select

informationHierarchy: 1. Current project status and key identifiers (name, client, status badge) — read before write
2. Allowed lifecycle transitions for the selected project (contextual action buttons)
3. Edit form for project details (name, client, site address, budget, dates)
4. Create new project form (collapsed / secondary until explicitly triggered)
objective.successCriteria: A project manager can register a new project, edit its details, and advance or revert its lifecycle status in the fewest possible steps, with the current state always visible before any mutation is confirmed.
antiPatterns: Free <select> over all status enum values for lifecycle transitions
Manually typed projectId or clientId fields
Separate page or route for each lifecycle operation
Stacking three independent forms with no shared project context
Showing system-owned fields (createdAt, updatedAt, closedAt, cancelledAt) as editable inputs
